integrity: The infinite-boundary statement is proved analytically by an initial-window formula and a convex-combination renewal recursion. Exact-rational computation is used only as an independent finite replay, not as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved only for the lattice support {1,m}.
The originality search was targeted rather than exhaustive; an equivalent formula could be implicit in older lattice-renewal literature.
title: Exact uniform mean overshoot for two-point lattice renewals
